name: AI Docs Review Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull request number to review'
        required: false
        type: string
      comment_id:
        description: 'ID of the slash command comment that triggered this workflow'
        required: false
        type: string
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # 12-15: Security model documentation
      - name: Security model
        run: |
          echo "This workflow runs with the permissions of the repository's default token."
          echo "It only accesses the PR branch via a checkout of refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head."
          echo "All API calls are authenticated with the default GITHUB_TOKEN, which has read/write access to the repository."
          echo "No secrets are exposed to the workflow steps."
        shell: bash

      # 63-71: Input validation step
      - name: Validate required inputs
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]]; then
            echo "pr input is missing"
            echo "missing=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "missing=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
        shell: bash

      # 83-93: Error comment posting if validation fails
      - name: Post error comment if inputs missing
        if: steps.validate.outputs.missing == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment_id }}
          body: |
            ❌ **Error**: The `pr` input is required for the `/ai-docs-review` command.
            Please provide a valid pull request number.
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          mode: replace

      # 98-104: Checkout using refs/pull/N/head
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          fetch-depth: 0

      # 106-137: File change detection with pagination
      - name: Detect changed files
        id: files
        run: |
          echo "Fetching changed files for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}..."
          FILES=$(gh api --paginate repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files --jq '.[].filename')
          echo "$FILES" > changed_files.txt
          echo "changed_files<<EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          cat changed_files.txt >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "EOF" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        shell: bash

      # 139-162: Start/skip comment posting
      - name: Post start comment
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment_id }}
          body: |
            🚀 **AI Docs Review** started for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}.
            Please wait while the AI processes the documentation changes.
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          mode: replace

      - name: Check for documentation changes
        id: doc_check
        run: |
          if grep -qE '^(docs/|docs/connector/)' changed_files.txt; then
            echo "docs_changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "docs_changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
        shell: bash

      - name: Post skip comment if no docs changes
        if: steps.doc_check.outputs.docs_changed == 'false'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@a35cf36e5301d70b76f316e867e7788a55a31dae
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment_id }}
          body: |
            ⚠️ No documentation changes detected. Skipping AI review.
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          mode: replace

      # 164-178: Devin action invocation
      - name: Run Devin AI review
        if: steps.doc_check.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment_id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs-pr-review"
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          start-message: "🔍 Running AI documentation review..."
          tags: ai-docs-review
          reuse-session: true
          wait-for-stopped-status: true
          wait-minutes-max: 10
          api-version: v1
